summary.text: Michelle Booker is the Democratic candidate for Delaware House of Representatives District 2 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the September 15, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Booker said she was born and raised in Southbridge and is running because she believes what the district has been doing is not working.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Booker said she was born and raised in Southbridge, and that she and her husband moved to East 23rd early in their marriage.
She said she saw gunfire and fear there firsthand and responded by starting programs, feeding people and knocking on doors.

Booker listed housing affordability and stopping tax-driven displacement, community safety and the fentanyl crisis, criminal justice reform, and early education as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
She said she would push for housing working families can afford, a public-health response to the fentanyl crisis and community-led safety.

sources.title: Michelle Booker - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2026)
